title: Repair Estimates & Appointments Desk Ruling: Earlier Goodwill Counted Against the Authority
content:
**Ruling.** When storage goodwill is worked out on a Repair Estimates & Appointments booking, which goodwill already booked counts against the goodwill authority follows the booking's state:

1. on a booking whose decline request is confirmed, only goodwill already booked against this storage statement charge counts;
2. on a booking in expired status, only goodwill booked within the last whole month before the statement date counts;
3. on every other booking this ruling does not narrow which goodwill counts.

The first state is read before the second: a booking whose decline request is confirmed is ruled by point 1.

**Cases** (hypothetical bookings, each carrying 40.00 USD of goodwill booked against a pre-repair scan charge two months ago and 10.00 USD of goodwill booked against the storage statement charge two weeks ago)

| Booking state | Goodwill that counts against the authority |
|---|---|
| Customer's decline request confirmed | 10.00 USD — only the goodwill against this storage statement charge |
| Expired | 10.00 USD — only the goodwill booked within the last whole month before the statement date |
| Neither | not narrowed by this ruling |

A variation: had the 40.00 USD on the scan charge been booked within the last whole month, an expired booking would count 50.00 USD, while a booking with a confirmed decline request would still count only the 10.00 USD against the storage statement charge.
